name: Joesley Batista
current_role: Co-controlling shareholder of J&F (holding company of JBS); slated chairman of J&F board after 2026 reorganization
profile: Joesley Batista and brother Wesley control J&F, the family holding behind JBS, one of the world's largest meat processors, which grew from father Jose Batista Sobrinho's butcher shop in Anapolis. He led JBS's international expansion (Swift 2007). In 2026 J&F was reorganized to fold in Eldorado, LHG Mining and Flora, with Joesley as chair.
interesting_fact: The empire began in 1953 as 'Casa de Carnes Mineira', a small butcher shop opened by his father 'Ze Mineiro' in Anapolis, Goias; today the brothers' J&F spans meat, pulp, mining, cosmetics, banking (PicPay) and energy.
deep_cut_fact: His father brought him into the family business at 16, when he was put in charge of a slaughterhouse with about 130 employees (J&F's own bio says his first role was manager at Flora Cosmeticos).

public_contacts.value: FSB Comunicacao (JBS Brasil corporate press): jbs@fsb.com.br

notes: Controversial past (2017 plea deal/bribery case, $3.2bn leniency fine); avoid in outreach. Route via J&F/JBS corporate press. Note: sources disagree on his first job (slaughterhouse manager vs. Flora manager).
